description: A MONROE mobile-network measurement campaign recorded access to cloud-hosted domains from nodes in Norway, Italy, Spain and Sweden between 5 April and 6 May 2017. The provider describes DNS lookups through operator and public resolvers, TCP and TLS connection times, UDP traceroutes, pings and radio metadata across commercial mobile operators. Zenodo lists one public 14.2 GB database-backup file under CC BY 4.0. These measurements could inform simulations of mobile-cloud latency, DNS replica choice or telecom dependency of transport services. The archive is an historic active-measurement collection, not a live service or current operator coverage map. A database schema is linked from the page, but that linked path was not queried because its GitHub username contains a personal name. The .bak file was not downloaded or restored, so tables, completeness and backup compatibility remain unverified. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this four-country MONROE cloud campaign.
name: The Cloud that Runs the Mobile Internet: A Measurement Study of Mobile Cloud Services
